newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Three companies shortlisted for Tanzania hotel.
newsitem.headline: Three companies shortlisted for Tanzania hotel.

text.p: Three foreign companies are shortlisted in bidding for the state-owned Kilimanjaro Hotel in Dar es Salaam, the government's privatisation commission said on Friday.
Jameson Nawita, spokesman for the parastatal sector reform commission, said the three were shortlisted from 18 applicants and a final decision on the new owner would be taken later this month.
He named the three as Kenya's Serena Lodges and Properties Ltd, South Africa's Stock and Resorts Hotels and British-based Feram Holdings.
The Kilimanjaro occupies a prime site overlooking Dar es Salaam harbour but needs renovation. The new owners will be required to bring the hotel to a five-star international standard.
